name: 89. GenAI generateContent image requests: inline image at any part position + imageConfig aspectRatio passthrough (genai-image-generate-content)
description:
Two silent-success defects on native Gemini image requests sent through the /genai route to Vertex. Both returned HTTP 200 with a well-formed image that ignored part of the request.

1. Image edit detection only inspected contents[0].parts[0]. With responseModalities IMAGE and the prompt text before the inlineData image, isImageEditRequest returned false, the request was classified as image generation, and ToBifrostImageGenerationRequest kept only the first text part. The image never reached Vertex (0 IMAGE prompt tokens) and the model invented a picture from the prompt alone. Google accepts inlineData at any position; its own Gemini API REST edit sample is text-first.

2. imageConfig.aspectRatio was folded into a WxH size string by convertImagenFormatToSize, which only knows 1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16 and 16:9 and defaults to square. ToGeminiImageGenerationRequest / ToGeminiImageEditRequest then derived 1:1 back from that size, so 3:2, 2:3, 21:9 and every other Gemini ratio was forwarded as 1:1. The fix copies aspectRatio into the typed aspect_ratio param, which both outbound converters now prefer over the size-derived ratio.

Cases: (A) text-first [text, inlineData] asserts IMAGE prompt tokens > 0; (B) text-to-image with aspectRatio 3:2 at 2K asserts the returned image decodes to a ~3:2 width/height; (C) image-first edit with a square input and aspectRatio 3:2 asserts the same on the edit path. B and C skip when the model answers without an image. There is no streaming variant: Vertex ImageGenerationStream is unsupported.

item.name: vertex/gemini-3-pro-image /genai generateContent imageConfig aspectRatio 3:2 returns a 3:2 image - genai-image-generate-content

exec: return parts.filter(function (p) { return p.inlineData && p.inlineData.data; })[0] || null;
// Sniff PNG/JPEG from the bytes: the /genai image response labels every image image/png.
pm.test('generation imageConfig.aspectRatio 3:2 is honored as 3:2, not collapsed to 1:1', function () {
pm.expect(img, 'no image came back in ' + attempts + ' attempt(s), so there is nothing to measure').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(dims, 'could not read image dimensions (mimeType ' + img.inlineData.mimeType + ')').to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(ratio, 'expected a 3:2 image, got ' + dims.w + 'x' + dims.h).to.be.within(1.4, 1.6);
// Gemini image generation occasionally answers without an image. That is model behavior, so
// the same request is sent again, at most twice, and the check fails if none brings one back.
pm.request.headers.each(function (h) { if (!h.disabled) { header.push({ key: h.key, value: pm.variables.replaceIn(h.value) }); } });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString()), method: 'POST', header: header, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.body.raw) } }, function (err, res) {
if (!err && res.code === 200) { try { img = imageOf(res.json()); } catch (e) { img = null; } }
